verdict.rationale: Viam documents its own non-production test environments: the setup wizard can run a machine in a simulated cloud environment for configuring and testing without hardware (viam-docs-77), Viam 101 is built entirely in simulation (viam-docs-78), and the RDK can be run with a dummy fake-component config (viam-gh-2). Nothing documents isolating these sandboxes from production data, or using them in agent-driven test workflows. Missing for 10: explicit separation from production data and orgs, documented agent and CLI workflows against simulated machines, and independent hands-on corroboration of the simulation sandbox.
